evaluation_kind: paired unblinding of independent reviewer reasoning over actual captured first brain requests
scope: One blinded reviewer, ten paired phrasings of one seeded watering reminder in a private DM. The existing fixture captured real messages/schemas while stubbing provider completion; a separate reviewer then reasoned over those public packets. The live semantic router was disabled.
interpretation: The observed difference is better task/context continuity in this direct-brain sample, not a before/after NLU accuracy score.
The baseline reviewer avoids inventing an action absent from its packet; its clarification is sensible given the supplied information.
The candidate reviewer uses the watering task in all ten cases, with eight scheduling proposals and two focused, appropriate time questions.
The two genuine time ambiguities are an unspecified point after 20:00 tonight and an unspecified AM/PM for seven tomorrow.
Exact pending IDs are supplied in candidate context but are not emitted/consumed by these create_reminder proposals; draft-ID execution is unmeasured here.
Three relative-time proposals follow the explicit receipt-time policy but fall before the separate processing clock in this fixture. They must not be reported as verified successful scheduling.

verified_separate_test_gates.qualification: These are separate deterministic/scripted test results, not additional independent language-model observations.

limitations: This reviewer is not the configured deployed Alex provider and no proposal was sent to MCP or WhatsApp.
Ingress was bypassed; missing baseline direct-brain context does not establish an ingress/WhatsApp failure.
The ten phrasings share one task, actor, conversation type and pending-state pattern and were selected for this regression area, not representative random or held-out usage.
History, structured state and in two pairs offered tools change together; the review cannot isolate their individual causal contributions.
There is one reviewer pass with no repeated sampling, model-to-model comparison, latency measurement or cost measurement.
The independent 24-scenario/48-turn holdout fixture is a different artifact and is not executed by this review.
